items.head: spend

items.source: Loi n° 2026-791, article 3 (amending article 4 of loi n° 2023-703): crédits de paiement of the mission Défense, EUR bn current

items.label: Large-company profits surcharge ends after 2026
items.head: tax
items.event: Loi de finances pour 2026, art. 12: contribution exceptionnelle sur les bénéfices des grandes entreprises extended for one more year (second financial year closed from 31 December 2025), threshold raised to EUR 1.5bn of turnover
items.source: Legifiscal (Sept 2026): the 2026 contribution is expected to raise EUR 7.3bn in 2026; LFI 2026 extends it for one year only (Simon Associés, Feb 2026); PLF 2027's further extension is not yet law
